assessment_scope: Formal independent first-pass Delivery Review of the sole registered primary-plan package at docs/plans/2026-09-16-test-design-and-suite-organization.md. The plan is the implicit primary-plan artifact under the selected record contract; docs/plan.md is navigation, not an additional delivery member. This assessment judges implementation sequencing and verification adequacy together against current Design Review ID design-review for model validation, the accepted proposal, the exact current plan, and relevant source/discovery/caller evidence. No work initialization or implementation is included.
independence_basis: The primary plan was authored by /root, recorded as codex-root/plan. Separate agent /root/proposal_reviewer performs this fresh assessment as delivery-reviewer/review. The reviewer previously assessed the proposal and Validation Design but did not author or edit either engineering subject or this plan. The reviewer read all 348 lines of the primary plan, inspected its current upstream authority and author evidence, independently checked source/caller and command feasibility, and selected the judgment without changing the plan, Design, activity or work. The author supplied the package and recording handoff, not the review conclusion.
limitations: This is approval of the exact primary-plan delivery package for authorized implementation. It neither initializes work nor executes milestones, and does not establish implementation correctness, completed reorganization, Code Review, final verification, branch/PR readiness or publication authority.

Detailed per-group protective-value dispositions, meaningful subtest/generated partitions and before/after runtime proof remain implementation duties under the approved allocation. The observed collection totals are a current feasibility baseline, not an exhaustive statement of semantic coverage.

Review used complete plan inspection, current approved Design/Proposal authority, author-recorded collection/authoring results and independent targeted source/caller checks. The reviewer did not rerun full scenario suites or claim hosted/public observations.

Future test, fixture, helper, caller or contract changes require the plan's applicable same-slice reconciliation, evidence reassessment and governed replanning where they change settled allocation. This judgment does not approve unknown future source moves or new product-behavior decisions.
rationale: Package and upstream authority are current. The registered primary plan matches the complete document inspected; the approved Validation member and its independent design-review remain unchanged, current and without findings. The plan operationalizes TEST-SR-19/20, VAL-SR-32 and VAL-DEC-11 while retaining existing proof-quality, discovery, execution, ownership and closeout criteria. The accepted complete-inventory direction is not narrowed into an oversized-file pilot, and the sole-plan membership is explicit.

Complete population allocation is credible. The plan names the mixed Skill class and its inherited methods, the remaining Skill classes/modules, seven domain-validator suites, selector/executor modules and generated child suites, both Packaging entrypoints, Release's aggregate/imported groups, all current package test files and four helpers, recursive fixtures and alternate execution consumers. Source inspection corroborated those current modules and package glob. The author's normal collection found 954 Python cases across 13 entrypoints and 418 Node cases across 22 files; these counts are used only as bounded discovery evidence. All 63 declared population-basis subject identities were independently re-inspected and matched at review time. Named subtests, generated partitions, reached populations outside conventional roots and additions since baseline still require source/caller and final reconciliation.

Requirement-to-proof traceability is complete at the plan level. TEST-SR-19/20 and VAL-SR-32 map through behavior/source composition to M1–M8, TG-01–08 and TG-FINAL-01. TEST-SR-01–10/12/17/18 map through contract boundaries, fixtures and consumers to every slice's dispositions, intended negative observations, C1 discovery and direct/C2 execution. VAL-SR-01–12/14/15/17/19–22/27 map through selector/adapter/executor and shared resources to M4/TG-04, same-slice reconciliation, C1–C3 and TG-FINAL-02/C4–C5. Retained product obligations have real owned observations in M5/TG-05, M6/TG-06, M7/TG-07 and M8/TG-08. Semantic assessment and applicability remain independently reviewed rather than inferred from collection or structural checks.

Milestone order and intermediate states are safe. M1 establishes the Skill support/aggregate boundary and M2 completes its remaining consumers; M3 covers domain validators before M4 addresses selector/executor fixtures and their direct CI probes. Packaging then Release retain artifact and local operational composition; Records then CLI/Installation complete package-local integration. Each successor depends on independent review and correction of its predecessor, and every slice owns its imports, fixtures, copied repositories, selectors and callers immediately. M8 performs final reconciliation rather than postponing earlier broken callers. New populations or settled-allocation changes return to Plan and Delivery Review when required.

Milestone boundaries are proportionate to the actual source responsibilities. Skill and Validation each receive two separate slices; Packaging, Release, Records and CLI/Installation receive their own primary boundaries. The largest groups retain explicit constituent populations and completion criteria rather than an undifferentiated whole-suite rewrite. Each milestone specifies implementation scope, required observations, commands, evidence, review handoff, risks and a recoverable unit. Suitable existing modules receive justified retention instead of compulsory churn, while unknown protection prevents affected completion.

Discovery and execution proof match the actual machinery. C1 invokes the existing discover_cases/discover_node_cases adapters in owned temporary directories; its glob is explicitly a starting set, with source-level subtest/generated and alternate-caller reconciliation required. C2 uses actual changed files, preserves selection reasons and runs every selected prerequisite/check. Catalog subset selectors for Packaging and the direct CI overlap cases were inspected. C3 matches the real two-worker CI probe, which is necessary because ordinary isolated-case allocation can provide only one worker. Direct full-suite proof, intended single-case reruns, hook preservation and renamed-identity mappings prevent a passing result caused by missing discovery.

Protection maintenance and oracle quality are adequately allocated. Every group requires an obligation, plausible failure, observation boundary, member/generated family, fixtures/helpers, consumers and a retain/strengthen/consolidate/replace/remove disposition. Before reducing protection, the plan requires established replacement detection or an already explicit owner retirement and independent assessment. Fault visibility, fresh nested mutable state, early cleanup, independent expected results, exact intended diagnostics and meaningful parameter preservation are part of implementation and review. Failing-before/passing-after or seeded violations are used where feasible; otherwise the inspected failure mechanism and relevant executed proof must justify detection. Counts and a green reduced suite are explicitly insufficient.

Product and authority boundaries remain intact. M5 retains real target archives, independently justified member inventories and packed CLI installation; M6 retains actual owned Git/filesystem persistence with controlled external-service observations and no publication authority; M7 retains public dispatch, byte preservation, contention, interruption and recovery; M8 retains actual CLI/install conflict, containment, replacement and race observations. The release-generated current-version fixture keeps its writer/path contract. Public release observations and owner freshness are not replaced by local fakes, and any discovered product-behavior conflict returns to its owner rather than being silently absorbed as fixture cleanup.

Compatibility, concurrency and recovery are sufficient. Pure moves preserve supported selectors, intentional names require mappings and consumer repair, and duplicate aliases cannot manufacture parity. Isolation evidence includes private roots, explicit environment/cwd, hooks, nested worker demand and real overlap/failure cleanup. Each rollback restores the coherent source/helper/fixture/aggregate/consumer unit from an owned pre-slice basis while retaining contradictory evidence and unrelated work. Unknown safety, protection or consumers block the affected completion. The plan does not introduce a new runner, cache, stored vocabulary, universal inheritance framework, behavior retirement or external mutation.

Integrated proof and final gates are separately allocated. TG-FINAL-01 requires accounted-for baseline/additional groups, meaningful parameters and dispositions; TG-FINAL-02 checks direct/selected/native composition, actual artifact and transaction observations, fixture isolation and reruns. C1 final reconciliation and C4/C5 execution are fresh obligations, including the actual working tree and one composed broad run. The final whole-change Code Review explicitly follows all eight implementation milestones and corrections, and distinct Verify follows that review. Milestone approval, evidence reuse and integrated test success cannot substitute for either gate.

Evidence expectations are realistic and bounded. The authoring record reports prose, whitespace and selected record/metadata/guide checks, while the population record reports normal collection without scenario-body execution. Neither is treated as implementation or complete protective-value proof. Later evidence requires exact subjects, actual commands, disposition rationale and limitations. Existing passes may be reused only with affirmative unchanged relevant basis and no fresh-execution override; current record-only checks do not force repeated unaffected expensive execution. Conditional PR-range proof requires separately authorized commits and an actual immutable head; no local result is promoted to hosted/main success.

Prior work and shared ownership are reconciled without expanding authority. The plan retains existing directory moves, recording-reference and selector pilots, independent archive proof, release helpers and the already absent query shim, while assigning remaining complete-suite obligations to this initiative. Earlier skill/support script audit and historical judgments retain their owners. CONTRIBUTING navigation and actual caller changes are same-slice obligations; any portable-policy conflict returns to the canonical owner and applicable generated consumers. There is no standalone test-spec substitute, permanent per-case ledger or deferred unassessed remainder.
summary: The primary plan allocates the complete test population into coherent reviewed slices with sufficient protection, discovery, isolation and consumer proof. Its sequence, recovery units and distinct final review/Verify dependencies are adequate for authorized implementation.
